implementation: Carry the unchanged pinned SDK AjvJsonSchemaValidator and its embedded Ajv engines/formats in the existing Win7 QuickJS runtime. Each client lazily owns one isolated persistent provider, preserving $id reuse. callTool resolves the held list even when TTL-stale, isolates caller overrides, rejects uncompilable output schemas before RPC, requires structured results and validates them unless isError is truthy. Close/disconnect resets the cache and reaps the validator; independent cancelled observers cannot cancel spawn or close ownership.

paired.scope: Actual SDK and Native callTool/cache methods with identical scripted request collaborators: default/07/2019/2020 drafts, formats, references, numeric/string/array/object constraints, unsupported dialects, missing refs and unfinished regexp class; missing/error results, override isolation, $id provider reuse, notification eviction and per-tool error isolation. Raw result/error objects and request packets compare exactly.

native_consumers.scope: HTTP/stdio and MCP direct consumers; the one new test wrongly assumed an invalid urn:owned schema identifier could compile. Source and Native both rejected it.

native_focused.scope: Corrected valid identifier, entire corpus in actual x86/x64 workers, real modern localhost HTTP structured output failure, actual child exit and held-spawn/cancelled-close observer ownership. No production changes after the consumer run.

source.scope: Pinned mcp-client, protocol, server-context and tool-definition suites.

diagnostics: First full pairing found only the V8/QuickJS unfinished regexp class error prose difference. A private RegExp adapter preserves this unambiguous observed diagnostic and leaves successful patterns unchanged. Initial/final raw observations retained; arbitrary other VM regexp syntax-error wording is not established by this corpus.

artifact.licenses: The SDK Apache license plus exact embedded dependency licenses retained. Original npm archives verified against published integrity; URLs/archive and member hashes in license-inputs.json. Modern Node is a build/comparison tool only.

cleanup.scope: All owned targeted workspaces/home/tmp, five redundant build outputs and verified license transfer archives removed; exact shipped artifact, manifests, logs/XML and original observations retained.

limitations: Caller-supplied schema-validator engines and shared response stores are not exposed by this host API.
Header mirroring/recovery and multi-leg total deadline remain pending separate contracts.
This is targeted verification, not pin promotion, release qualification or an actual Windows 7 run.
